Roles and permissions

Program leads record progress for assigned awards. Finance staff attach receipts. A grants manager approves reports and can export a funder summary.

Build prompt

Build “Grant Compliance & Reporting Tracker” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Track each reporting period, due date, owner, evidence and outstanding requirements. Log the actor and time for every progress entry and approval. Freeze an approved report and keep the approval history. Program leads record progress for assigned awards. Finance staff attach receipts. A grants manager approves reports and can export a funder summary. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

Start with 12 of 20 sessions and one missing receipt. Log four sessions with an evidence reference to reach 80%. Approval stays blocked until finance links the receipt. Approve once and export the same 16-session total and decision history.
